statement: The record shows a conflicting state—USD 148,300 is marked unpaid and due, but it also records full payment on 3 September under PAY-2291—so I will hold the invoice to avoid a duplicate payment.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer names the specific contradiction—"USD 148,300 is marked unpaid and due, but it also records full payment on 3 September under PAY-2291"—and refuses to pay to avoid duplication.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
